cohort: Pregnant women who delivered or had a maternal death in the US (2004-2014)
finding: Women with IIH had a higher incidence of obstetrical complications, including preterm deliveries, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, and congenital anomalies.
mod_finding: Women with idiopathic intracranial hypertension had a higher rate of cesarean delivery compared to those without (aOR 2.41, 95% CI: 2.12-2.73, P < 0.001).
